mcq_fix.s: Which of the following was ranked the world's fastest supercomputer in 2020-21?
mcq_fix.why: odd wording; Fugaku is no longer the fastest, so the item needs a time frame

mcq_drop.why: opinion item; whether datasets count is arguable

patterns: Direct one-liners dominate: father of AI = John McCarthy (APPSC), qubit = quantum computing, Imitation Game = Turing test.
Bullet-proof vest fibre = Kevlar (aromatic polyamide) is the most repeated materials question across PSCs.
Current-year 'International Year' items (2025 = Quantum Science and Technology) and Micius quantum satellite recur.
App MCQs go deep into Indian labs/developers and 2026 news (Majorana 2, RRI quantum flip) well beyond PYQ depth.
